import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    l = int(data[1])
    r = int(data[2])
    
    if n == 0:
        total_bits = 1
    else:
        total_bits = n.bit_length()
    
    l = max(1, l)
    r = min(total_bits, r)
    
    if l > r:
        print(n)
        return
    
    num_bits_to_set = r - l + 1
    mask = ((1 << num_bits_to_set) - 1) << (total_bits - r)
    
    result = n | mask
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
